title: Dependencies: 14 behind
summary: Upgrade round: the outdated packages with what each major bump breaks in this code, then which ones go in now.
description: `npm outdated` lists 14 packages. The 10 minor and patch updates pass the tests together. I read the changelogs of the 4 major ones against this codebase: here's what each would touch. Pick this round's scope.

fields.label: The four majors
fields.text:
| Package | Now → latest | What it breaks here | Work |
|---|---|---|---|
| react, react-dom | 18.3 → 19.2 | `forwardRef` in 3 components (`ref` is a prop now) | ~1 h |
| vite | 5.4 → 7.1 | Node 20.19+ needed; our config is fine | ~15 min |
| eslint | 8.57 → 9.36 | `.eslintrc` must become a flat `eslint.config.js` | ~30 min |
| zod | 3.23 → 4.1 | error-message API renamed, 41 call sites | ~2 h |

fields.label: Which major upgrades now?
fields.help: Zod 4 is the only one with real churn; I'd give it its own round.
